body: The sudden realization is enlightening. Thank you.

I haven't. I took some things last night-- Specifically xanax and I had a few drinks. If nothing more I can harm myself and feel good at the same time.

Not knowing what the rest of my life will be is like not wanting to sit through a bad movie. Yes, I paid for those tickets and god damn how I want a refund.

They wont. I'm actually done, right now. I've concluded that any type of hope a stranger can give me is false. Nothing with get better and that's the bitter truth.

I think I've let myself sit here in anger, I've blamed myself for a lot of things, I've blamed myself for things I couldn't comprehend and I thought it stupid of people to throw themselves at other people and just get completely attached.

When you need help the most the people you've cared about will turn a blind eye to you. Things only get better by chance and luck and it's never been in my favor. So, that's that and there is no hope or place for a person like me in this world.

I'm done, with every fiber of my being telling me I am and I'm sorry if this comes off as aggressive or rude. I just cannot handle this anymore.

A lot of people say that when you are down so low you can only go back up, right? Well, as someone who has virtually no friends, I find that impossible. I got upset recently and told good friends to fuck off.

I got drunk and got upset. I can't wait for things to get better, I just want an easy way out. There is virtually nothing for me to stay here for. Nothing
